benefits: Exemption from paying tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
Economy class air ticket to Brunei Darussalam before the course begins and an economy class return air ticket on completion
Monthly personal allowance of BND$500.00 and monthly meals allowance of BND$150.00
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration of the scholarship, plus baggage allowance for shipment of personal effects on completion (max BND$250.00 within ASEAN / BND$500.00 outside ASEAN)
eligibility: Not exceed the age of 25 for Undergraduate and Diploma programmes, or 35 for Postgraduate Master's Degree programmes, on the first day of July of the year the course/programme starts
Be proficient in English with a Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level Examination, or a Grade 'C' in IGCSE English (as a second language), or an IELTS score of 6.0, or a TOEFL minimum score of 550
The Scholarship is intended primarily for international students studying for the first time in Brunei Darussalam
Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents and international students studying/who have studied in Brunei tertiary institutions are NOT eligible

Upload all required documents in the application form; ineligible applications will be rejected
Applicants applying to Universiti Brunei Darussalam (UBD) must also complete an online application through https://apply.ubd.edu.bn/orbeon/uis-welcome/
Applicants applying to Universiti Teknologi Brunei (UTB) must also complete an online application through https://apply.utb.edu.bn/
Be available for an interview at a place determined by the institution offering the programme and for a written examination in English/Malay/Arabic where applicable
Read all information regarding the courses/programmes before submitting the application form; only BDGS-listed programmes qualify

Certified true copies of Birth Certificate and Passport
References and recommendations from referees using the ministry's C1 and C2 reference letter format
Certified English translations of any supporting document that is not in English
selection_criteria: Selection of candidates is made by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and its decision is final; any disputes or enquiries will not be entertained
Applicants may be required to appear for an interview at such place(s) as determined by the institutions offering the programmes
A written examination may be used to assess proficiency in the English/Malay/Arabic language (where applicable)
Successful applicants will be contacted or notified for further consideration in the selection process; unsuccessful applicants will be notified through email
coverage: Full tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
Economy class air ticket to Brunei before the course and economy class return air ticket on completion
Monthly personal allowance of BND 500 plus monthly meals allowance of BND 150
Accommodation at the residential college of the University/Polytechnic
Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration; baggage allowance for personal effects on completion up to BND 250 (ASEAN) or BND 500 (outside ASEAN)
application_method: Fill in the online BDGS Application Form on the Government of Brunei Darussalam application portal linked from the MFA scholarship page
Upload the required documents (ID, certified academic documents, certified translations, birth certificate/passport, C1 and C2 references) in the application form
UBD applicants must also complete the online admission application at https://apply.ubd.edu.bn/orbeon/uis-welcome/

official.application_route: Apply online through the MFA's BDGS application form on the Government portal, uploading all certified documents; applicants to UBD or UTB must also submit the university's own online admission application.
official.citizenship_residency: Intended primarily for international students studying for the first time in Brunei Darussalam; Bruneians, Brunei Permanent Residents and international students studying/who have studied in Brunei tertiary institutions are NOT eligible.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - open to foreign (non-Bruneian) applicants; any current or prior study at a Brunei tertiary institution disqualifies an applicant.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must apply for a programme offered under the BDGS at one of the five participating institutions: Universiti Brunei Darussalam (UBD), Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali (UNISSA), Universiti Teknologi Brunei (UTB), Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan (KUPU SB) and Politeknik Brunei (PB).
official.duration: Diploma, Undergraduate Degree or Postgraduate Master's Degree programme; the academic year commences July/August.
official.description: The Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship to Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS) is administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and offers Diploma, Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Master's Degree study at five institutions of higher education in Brunei: Universiti Brunei Darussalam, Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali, Universiti Teknologi Brunei, Kolej Universiti Perguruan Ugama Seri Begawan and Politeknik Brunei. The scholarship covers tuition, economy air travel, accommodation, insurance and monthly allowances for the duration of the programme.
official.english_requirement: Credit 6 at GCE 'O' Level Examination, or Grade 'C' in IGCSE English (as a second language), or an IELTS score of 6.0, or a TOEFL minimum score of 550.

applicant_utility.summary: This is Brunei's flagship government scholarship for first-time international students at Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's level, run once a year by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with a December opening and mid-February close. The 2026/2027 round closed on 15 February 2026, so watch the MFA BDGS page from early December for the next intake for July/August entry. Check the age rule before anything else: 25 or under for diploma and bachelor's, 35 or under for master's, measured on 1 July of your entry year. If you have ever studied at a Bruneian tertiary institution, or hold Brunei Permanent Resident status, you are excluded no matter how strong your grades are.
applicant_utility.best_fit: School leavers and recent graduates under the age limits who want a fully funded English-medium degree in Asia and can prove school-level or test-based English proficiency.
application_readiness_checklist: Monitor the official BDGS page from early December onward; the scheme is annual and the portal only opens during the application window
Obtain certified true copies of your birth certificate, passport/national ID and full academic transcripts early, with certified English translations for anything not in English
Brief two referees well before the window opens so the C1 and C2 reference letters are ready to upload
If your school results lack Credit 6 GCE 'O' Level or Grade 'C' IGCSE English, book IELTS (6.0) or TOEFL (550) early
Shortlist BDGS-eligible programmes at UBD, UNISSA, UTB, KUPU SB or Politeknik Brunei and check each institution's entry qualifications against your transcripts
Prepare the separate UBD (apply.ubd.edu.bn) or UTB (apply.utb.edu.bn) admission application in parallel if that is your target institution
common_rejection_risks: Being over the age limit on 1 July of the intake year - 25 for diploma/bachelor's, 35 for master's - the age is measured at the course start, not the application date
Having studied, or currently studying, at any Brunei tertiary institution, which makes you ineligible however strong your application
Holding Bruneian nationality or Brunei Permanent Resident status
Uploading incomplete document sets: missing certified English translations, birth certificate/passport copies or referee letters
Assuming the English requirement is waived without the accepted school-level results
Holding another scholarship, fellowship, grant or loan without prior MFA approval, which voids the award once discovered
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Day-to-day costs beyond the BND 500 monthly personal and BND 150 monthly meals allowances, any extra insurance the recipient chooses on top of the comprehensive cover provided, travel to any interview venue, and any family-related costs (bringing family is discouraged and unfunded).
document_audit: Every non-English document needs a certified English translation - uncertified or machine translations are not acceptable
References must follow the ministry's C1 and C2 reference letter format published on the BDGS page
Certified true copies, not plain photocopies, are required for the birth certificate and passport
Certificates, testimonials and transcripts are all expected; uploading one without the others leaves the application incomplete
alerts: The cycle is strictly annual: the 2026/2027 application closed on 15 February 2026 and the next session's dates have not been announced, so nothing can be submitted until the next window opens
Age is calculated on 1 July of the year your course starts, which can disqualify applicants who are eligible at application time
Recipients must leave Brunei immediately upon completing the programme and cannot take paid employment or serve on the staff of any country's mission in Brunei during the scholarship
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs reserves the right to reject any application and its decision is final, with no appeals entertained
Successful and unsuccessful applicants are both notified by email, so keep a monitored inbox - the ministry's queries address for the last cycle was queriesBDGS2025@mfa.gov.bn
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the BDGS online form on the Government portal with all certified uploads, simultaneously submit the UBD or UTB admission application where required, then await a possible interview and written English/Malay/Arabic test with results notified by email.
